beats.say: Your password is probably one leak away from being useless.
When a website gets hacked, your password can leak, and then somebody else can try it everywhere.
So add a second lock. Two step verification asks for a code from your phone, even when someone has your password.
It takes two minutes. Open your email settings, find security, and switch it on.
If you can, pick an authenticator app instead of text messages, because it is generally safer.
Do it today, and send this to someone who uses one password for everything.

youtube.title: Your password isn't enough (do this in 2 minutes) 🔐
youtube.description:
Turn on two-step verification so a leaked password alone can't open your email. Prefer an authenticator app over text messages when you can.
